item.title: New commander for U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Little Rock District
item.description: Col. Eric R. Swenson has assumed command of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Little Rock District, which manages $30 billion in federal water resource infrastructure, including 12 multipurpose lakes, 13 locks and dams, 308 miles of navigation, 138 parks, and seven hydroelectric plants.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Blog: Does the drought persist or improve this Spring?
item.description: The drought has persisted on and off since June of 2025, but it deepened from November 2025 to the present. It'll take between 11 and about 20 inches of rainfall over the next 2 months to lift Arkansas out of the drought. The latest seasonal drought outlook shows a lot of the state may persist in drought through the end of May, but northeast Arkansas may improve.

item.title: Lonoke County candidates concerned after county clerk resigns week before primary elections
item.description: On Sunday, Lonoke County Clerk Dawn Porterfield posted a resignation letter effective immediately. This came in the middle of early voting, with the primary election a week away.

item.title: Little Rock native speaks on Puerto Vallarta cartel attacks after explosive hits her hotel
item.description: Puerto Vallarta has been Lacey Olson and her husband Sam's go-to vacation spot for several years. They arrived to their hotel on the beach on Saturday, a day before the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Reuben "El Mencho" Cervantes, was killed in a Mexican military operation.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.
